title: South Korean officials are probing whether AI agents were used in recent bank hacks, after President Lee Jae Myung said "signs" suggest AI models were involved (New York Times)
summary: New York Times: South Korean officials are probing whether AI agents were used in recent bank hacks, after President Lee Jae Myung said “signs” suggest AI models were involved — The president said there were signs that such models were used in recent attacks on several banks involving customer data.
